### The connection of wind power to the price

21.1.2026 2025 preliminary statistics 27

Data: Entso-e & Finnish Energy

• On windy days the price of electricity is often close to zero, on days with little wind the price is higher 
• The amount of wind power is the biggest factor affecting prices, but many other factors also affect prices: 

o Regarding demand, e.g. day of the week, time of day, heating demand, industrial occupancy rate, etc.

o Regarding supply, e.g. availability of power plants and border lines, fuel and emission costs, water situation, etc.
